text:
Ravi P.: Heads up - during the v2 gradual rollout we hit a telemetry mismatch where the console preview showed positive billing delta but raw tokens for some tenants didn't move. Looks like route tagging vs. billing attribution are out of sync.

Hannah K.: Same. I traced a few requests: routing decided v1 for slow-client fallback but model-selection emitted model=v2 in the enrichment step. Both fields are being ingested which leads to duplicated aggregate keys.

Diego M.: Can you paste one example trace?

Ravi P.: trace: tr_2025_1101. Logs: 
2025-01-11T15:04:01Z routing: policy=compat_fallback chosen=v1 tenant=beta-inc trace=tr_2025_1101
2025-01-11T15:04:01Z enrichment: model_select=model-v2 variant=quantized trace=tr_2025_1101
So two different attributes.

Priya V.: UX impact: our rollforward preview (console) surfaced "expected delta +4%" which will scare customers. Short-term we should stop showing billing delta until attribution is canonicalized.

Ravi P.: Agreed short-term mitigation: flip console preview to sample-only mode and add a red "attribution mismatch" banner until backend is fixed.

Hannah K.: Medium-term fix: set a canonical header X-Redwood-Attribution at routing decision time (value=v1|v2). Make downstream enrichment and ETL respect it (no overrides). Also update ETL precedence to prefer that header.

Diego M.: Implementation notes:
- Routing change: set header before proxying to model selection. Add unit tests for header propagation.
- Enrichment: guard so it only sets model_variant if header absent.
- ETL: treat X-Redwood-Attribution as primary attribution key.
Estimate: routing ~4-6hrs, enrichment ~2hrs, ETL ~6hrs incl deploy and small sample backfill.

Priya V.: I'll update console copy and hide billing delta by default for the next 24h rollout waves. Also drafting a short tenant-facing note if they see discrepancies.

Ravi P.: Owners: Ravi (routing PR), Hannah (ETL), Diego (enrichment), Priya (console + comms). Ops-bot, please schedule a low-impact 1% backfill window for validation.

ops-bot: Acknowledged - scheduling backfill window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC, will page oncall if CPU > 70%.

Hannah K.: One more thing - let's conservatively attribute missing header cases to v1 in billing to protect customers until the fix is fully rolled out.

Ravi P.: Good call. We'll add that to the ETL change and document it in the postmortem. Thanks everyone.
